title: Hardship Desk Calculation: Overdue Interest Cover in a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Good-Faith Payment
content:
**Hardship desk calculation, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — interest cover for a seriously or moderately overdue contract.**

**Rule.** The per diem is the contract's principal balance times its APR divided by 100 and by the product's day basis of 365 days, rounded to the cent; the days past due are the calendar days from the contract's next due date to today. When the days past due exceed 30, the good-faith amount also covers the per diem for each day past due beyond 30; when the days past due exceed the product's grace period of 10 days but not 30, it covers the per diem for half of the days past due beyond 10, rounded down to a whole day; in every other case it covers no days of interest. The interest cover is the per diem times the days covered, rounded to the cent.

The day basis (365) and the grace period (10 days) are the same on Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5, Tier 4, Tier 3, Tier 2, Tier 1 and Tier 1+. The interest cover is added to the good-faith amount after the good-faith percentage has been applied to the monthly payment and rounded.

**Counting.** A count of calendar days from one date to another is the second date less the first, so the first date is not counted and the second is; the count is zero or negative when the second date is not after the first.

| Days past due | Days of interest covered |
|---|---|
| more than 30 | the days past due less 30 |
| 11 to 30 | half of the days past due less 10, rounded down |
| 10 or fewer | none |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Principal balance 21,900.00 dollars at an APR of 5.00 percent: the per diem is 21,900.00 times 5.00 divided by 100 and by 365, which is 3.00 dollars.

- 37 days past due: 7 days covered, interest cover 21.00 dollars.
- 30 days past due: half of 20 is 10 days covered, 30.00 dollars.
- 15 days past due: half of 5 is 2.5, rounded down to 2 days, 6.00 dollars.
- 10 days past due: no days covered.
